scenario.title: API v2 change + 429 storm + crash/resume (scripted planner, Oct 10)
scenario.description: NovaBill switches to API v2 mid-migration (plan_code -> price_id, lower-case currency) during a 429 storm; a timeout-after-write and a partial batch follow, then the process is killed and resumed from the ledger. Demo dataset (300 customers).

summary.goal: Move all customers, subscriptions and invoices from LegacyBill to NovaBill. Do not lose or duplicate anything.

events.message: run created: Move all customers, subscriptions and invoices from LegacyBill to NovaBill. Do not lose or duplicate anything.

customers.rationale: Split full_name, normalize email/country case, local dates in Asia/Kolkata to UTC; skip soft-deleted.

invoices.rationale: Amounts to ISO-4217 minor units per currency; issue dates are UTC; empty sub_id -> null.

subscriptions.rationale: Plan code is the catalog lookup_key. Naive start times are Asia/Kolkata wall-clock.
